messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed in us-west2 for inference-gateway (rollup). Current error rate > 7% over 3m window. Paging on-call (morgan). :rotating_light:

morgan: on it — getting context. squad oncall: @jamie? can you confirm if any deploys in the last 30m?

jamie: no deploys from infra or runtime in last hour. saw a few spikes in backend latency though. linking perf dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/regions/us-west2/inference-gateway

sean: seeing 502s in the gateway logs, root appears to be downstream model-pool returning 5xx under load. sample log:```
2026-04-02T14:12:03Z error gateway request_id=abcd123 status=502 backend=rpc-inference node=inf-pool-7 msg="upstream error: delayed response"
2026-04-02T14:12:05Z warn  backend=kv-cache node=cache-3 latency=1.2s
```

morgan: ok — estimate impact: approx 15% of requests from us-west2 are failing or timing out, customers hitting higher latencies and some streaming disconnects. Loading customer-affect map...

katie: FYI support reported two customers noticing degraded completions in us-west2 (acct: acme.ai, eqalpha). opening status page draft.

morgan: initial mitigation plan: 1) throttle/disable autoscale burst for model-pool-7 2) shift traffic away from us-west2 -> prefer-us-east routing 3) increase per-pod concurrency limits on healthy nodes 4) run diagnostic on model binaries for OOMs. Agree?

jamie: +1 for shift traffic. We should enable fallback policy to target compatible model-variant (gpt-medium-quant) in us-east to preserve capacity.

sean: trying a graceful routing change now — will flip routing weight for api-route /v1/generate to prefer region=us-east (10s TTL). command:```
rw-router update-route --name inference-generate --set-weight region=us-east:0.8,region=us-west2:0.2 --reason "emerg: us-west2 5xx"
```

incident-bot: Action logged: routing update requested by sean at 2026-04-02T14:14:20Z.

morgan: executing runbook step A: check pod health and restart misbehaving pods. runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/inference/gateway-fallback

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook step A started: `restart-unhealthy-pods` (target label=app=inference-gateway, region=us-west2). Estimated time 2-4m.

jamie: I'm seeing long GC pauses on a subset of model workers, likely due to large batch queueing. `kubectl top pods -n inference` shows nodes at 92% mem.

sean: restarted 3 pods (inf-gw-7, inf-worker-11, inf-worker-12). After restart we see partial drop in 5xx, error rate down to ~4.5%. Continuing to shift traffic.

morgan: good. I'm increasing kv-cache TTL for us-west2 to reduce backend pressure:```
redis-cli -h cache-us-west2 setex prefix_cache 300 "on"
```

katie: status page updated and published (minor degraded performance, partial regional outage for us-west2). customer-facing note: we are investigating elevated errors and routing traffic to other regions. link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/USW2-20260402

sean: routing change completed — 80% to us-east. monitoring cross-region latency: us-east latency +30ms but within SLOs for most customers.

jamie: new errors mostly gone, but we still see intermittent 504s from a legacy proxy cluster in us-west2 (proxy-edge-legacy). I recommend draining that pool and shifting the ingress to proxy-edge-new.

morgan: draining proxy-edge-legacy now (conn draining 60s). command:```
kubectl cordon proxy-edge-legacy-1 && kubectl drain proxy-edge-legacy-1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```

incident-bot: NOTE: auto-scaler triggered at 2026-04-02T14:20:15Z in us-east for model-shard group (new nodes provisioning). Estimated ready ~3m.

sean: after drains and pod restarts, error rate in us-west2 stabilized to ~1%. overall cluster errors across regions down to 0.7%.

morgan: excellent. next: follow-up actions tracked in #incidents-runbook: 1) replace proxy-edge-legacy in us-west2 2) analyze heap/GC traces on affected workers 3) evaluate autoscaler thresholds to avoid noisy scaling 4) postmortem-owner assignment. volunteers?

katie: I'll coordinate customer comms and timeline. assigning postmortem ownership to jamie and sean.

jamie: will take infra root cause for proxy-edge and autoscaler tuning. sean: you'll take runtime/model-pool part?

sean: yep. I'll grab logs, perf traces, and the kernel/quantization metrics.

morgan: final status: mitigation complete, traffic shifted, customers rerouted, partial outage resolved. closing page at 2026-04-02T14:34:20Z but leaving incident channel open for handoff + postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: us-west2 gateway error spike mitigated. Incident record: INC-2026-0573. Please file postmortem within 72h.

katie: adding timeline and immediate mitigations to the incident doc. will ping when postmortem draft is ready.

morgan: thanks team — great coordination. I’ll schedule a 30m blameless postmortem for tomorrow to capture ops/engineering action items.

sean: one FYI leftover: discovered a config drift in proxy-edge-legacy where `max_keepalive` was 50 (should be 500). capturing that in the ticket.

jamie: noted. adding remediation: upgrade proxy-edge-legacy nodes and add config lint in CI.

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook completed. Steps taken: restart pods, drain legacy proxies, route fallback to us-east, increase cache TTL, monitor autoscaler.

morgan: thread will remain pinned until postmortem is published. thanks all.
